visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand holds a smartphone vertically, displaying an Instagram post featuring a woman in a white fur coat standing in an outdoor park. (2) The scene cuts to a woman with long brown hair wearing a pink hoodie and white pants; she spins around holding a purple foam roller against a purple, space-like background with animated hearts and stars. (3) The background shifts to a modern indoor living room with a white brick wall and indoor plants; the woman holds her phone toward the camera while smiling and gesturing. (4) The camera focuses on an extreme close-up of the phone screen, showing the '30 Day Fitness Challenge' app interface; fingers navigate through height and weight settings (162cm, ~40kg) and training schedules. (5) The woman is seen in a medium full shot doing inclined push-ups on a gray sofa in the living room; she wears the same pink hoodie and white sweatpants. (6) She leans into the camera for a close-up, talking excitedly, and finally swings the purple foam roller at the camera lens as a playful conclusion.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced, bright electronic synth music begins immediately. A high-pitched female voice energetically introduces herself as a 'fitness fairy.' (2) A sharp, percussive hit SFX punctuates a transition. A male voice playfully interrupts with a mocking tone, followed by the female shouting 'Shut up!' in an exaggerated comic manner. (3) The female voice transitions into a narrative pitch, explaining the app features with high articulation clarity. Occasional digital 'bubble' SFX trigger as she describes downloading the app. (4) The female narrator's speech rate increases as she describes inputting data. A sudden male interjection asks about the weight, followed by another 'Shut up' hit SFX. (5) As the fitness demonstration begins, the male voice changes to a high-arousal cheering style, repeatedly shouting compliments with rhythmic enthusiasm. (6) The video concludes with a loud 'thud' SFX matching the visual foam roller hit, and a final playful vocal exchange with a cartoonish 'anger' sound effect.
